title: Alternating sum over an interval of subsets
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $T,U\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ be finite sets with $T\subseteq U$. The sum of $(-1)^{|S|-|T|}$ over all sets $S$ with $T\subseteq S\subseteq U$ equals $1$ if $T=U$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
